partnershipPlan: Two patients with type 2 diabetes, one who attends groups and one who does not, review the invitation letter and the questionnaire; practice nurses review the session plan.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Hearing how someone else got their sugars down did more for me than any leaflet.
items.implication: Keep peer discussion at the centre of each session.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I did not want my neighbour hearing my weight and blood results.
items.implication: Include short individual time and let patients switch back.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: The group is on a Wednesday afternoon; I am on the line until six.
items.implication: Offer evening sessions and record work status.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Once you have run the groups, you start giving the same talks in individual reviews.
items.implication: Separate nurses between arms where possible and record usual care.

summary: Four composite voices on peer learning, privacy, shift work and contamination.
